A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F are readable and can be matched despite relocations and the added checklist.

before.justification: v1 reports original hedging simulations, adversarial attack evaluations, and stock-market experiments, including the supplementary results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulation and market-data results in Section 5 and Appendix E.

M1.justification: The WPGD/WBPGD algorithms, adversarial training objective, architectures, and model extensions are retained. Renaming the GAD heading from 'Square Loss' to 'Entropic Risk Measure' corrects terminology: v1 already specifies entropic risk in the accompanying text.

E1.justification: Both versions cover Black–Scholes, Heston, transaction costs, parameter shifts, GAD-based FIX/ROBUST datasets, and the same five-stock market evaluations. GAD and the 300-trajectory REAL dataset already appear in v1; their increased prominence does not add coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: WPGD/WBPGD with S/SV attacks, clean versus adversarial training, and Deep Hedging versus Robust Deep Hedging on market datasets. The added citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Detailed protocols are retained, but v2 Section 5.2 adds GAD to the model list preceding a one-million-path test-set description. Section 5.4 still specifies 100,000 paths for GAD-based FIX/ROBUST testing, as v1 did. The PDFs do not resolve whether this reflects an intended setting revision or an overgeneralized summary.

E4.justification: The covariance/ACF checks, perturbation-radius comparisons, sample-size analyses, parameter-shift tests, and transaction-cost architecture comparisons are retained. v1 Section 5.3 and its robustness table move to v2 Appendix E.2 without adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Min–max ranges across training partitions and reported variances remain unchanged. Averaging over three clean-training runs and six adversarial hyperparameter configurations moves from v1 Section 6 to v2 Appendix E.5. The checklist repeats existing uncertainty-reporting information.

E6.justification: All ten tables retain their numerical entries after matching relocations and renumbering, and Figures 1–5 retain identical plots. For example, Table 6 still reports Heston mean losses of 2.8644 for SV-Attack and 6.2095 for clean training at N = 5,000.

T1.justification: The assumptions, theorems, lemmas, corollaries, and derivations in the main text and Appendices A–C/F are retained. References change from Equation C.5 to the equivalent Equation 3.9, and projection notation is clarified without changing the mathematics.

C1.justification: v2 explicitly presents real-market robustness during market stress and comparison with Robust Deep Hedging as headline contributions, and adds a conclusion. These claims draw on experiments already present in v1; the central method and generalization claims remain intact.

C2.justification: The radius-sensitivity limitation, nominal-performance/robustness trade-off, explanation of benefits with limited data, and warning about outdated parameter intervals are retained. The conclusion and checklist do not add substantive scientific explanations or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: The new checklist states that reproduction code and instructions accompany the supplement. The repository link, architecture, hyperparameters, hardware, and runtimes are retained. It also adds declarations of no existing or newly released assets, which conflict with the described market-data use and code provision.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Bai et al. on distributional adversarial training, Buehler et al. on hedging under generic market frictions, and Biagini et al. on superhedging. Related work expands its DRO/adversarial-training discussion while retaining the central novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v2 revises the abstract, contribution bullets, and related work; incorporates market experiments into Section 5; moves robustness details into the appendix; and adds a conclusion, acknowledgments, and checklist. Most technical exposition remains unchanged, with limited terminology and cross-reference corrections.

P2.justification: v1 Table 3 becomes appendix Table 4, while the market P&L table changes from Table 4 to Table 3. Appendix tables and figures are regrouped, including placing Figures 4 and 5 together. Plot content and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting the GAD loss heading and improving the conclusion and related-work exposition offer modest benefits. However, v2 introduces conflicting GAD test-size descriptions and inconsistent checklist asset declarations. With methods, proofs, and results retained, these editorial gains and reporting problems leave the net direction of overall quality uncertain.
